modelProviderApiKeys.zh: 模型提供商 API 密钥

modelProviderApiKeysDescription.en: Manage your API keys for third-party model providers
modelProviderApiKeysDescription.zh: 管理第三方模型提供商的 API 密钥

desktopIndividualDescription.en: Manage your {{product}} API keys and privacy settings.
desktopIndividualDescription.zh: 管理你的 {{product}} API 密钥与隐私设置。

displayLanguageDescription.en: Select your preferred language for the UI
displayLanguageDescription.zh: 选择你偏好的界面语言

enableAccessToOpenAIModelsWithDataRetent.en: Enable access to OpenAI models with data retention
enableAccessToOpenAIModelsWithDataRetent.zh: 允许访问带数据保留的 OpenAI 模型

enableAccessToOpenAIModelsWithDataRetent.en: Unlocks additional OpenAI models that require data retention for trust and safety verification.
enableAccessToOpenAIModelsWithDataRetent.zh: 解锁需要数据保留以进行信任与安全验证的额外 OpenAI 模型。

openaiCyberRetentionDescription.en:
Unlocks additional OpenAI models that require data retention for trust and safety verification.

OpenAI stores this data for up to 30 days and does not use it for model training or improvement. This setting applies only to OpenAI models.
openaiCyberRetentionDescription.zh:
解锁需要数据保留以进行信任与安全验证的额外 OpenAI 模型。

OpenAI 最多保留这些数据 30 天，不会将其用于模型训练或改进。此设置仅适用于 OpenAI 模型。

allowModelProviderDataRetention.zh: 允许模型提供商保留数据

allowModelProviderDataRetentionDescripti.en: Allow model providers to store data for up to 30 days for automated harm detection. Data will NOT be used for model training or improvements.
allowModelProviderDataRetentionDescripti.zh: 允许模型提供商最多保留数据 30 天，用于自动化危害检测。数据不会被用于模型训练或改进。

allowModelProviderDataRetentionDisabledD.en: Disabling this setting disables all routing to Fable-family models.
allowModelProviderDataRetentionDisabledD.zh: 关闭此设置会停用所有到 Fable 系列模型的路由。

ultraModelProviderRetentionDescription.en: Some model providers may retain data for up to 30 days for automated harm detection. Data will NOT be used for model training or improvements.
ultraModelProviderRetentionDescription.zh: 部分模型提供商可能保留数据最多 30 天，用于自动化危害检测。数据不会被用于模型训练或改进。

enableAccessToAnthropicModelsWithDataRet.en: Enable access to Anthropic models with data retention
enableAccessToAnthropicModelsWithDataRet.zh: 允许访问带数据保留的 Anthropic 模型

enableAccessToAnthropicModelsWithDataRet.en: Unlocks additional Anthropic models that require data retention for trust and safety verification, such as Claude Fable 5.
enableAccessToAnthropicModelsWithDataRet.zh: 解锁需要数据保留以进行信任与安全验证的额外 Anthropic 模型，例如 Claude Fable 5。

accessEnabledForAnthropicModelsWithZeroD.en: Access enabled for Anthropic models with zero data retention
accessEnabledForAnthropicModelsWithZeroD.zh: 已为 Anthropic 模型启用零数据保留访问

allowDataRetention.zh: 允许模型提供商保留数据

allowDataRetentionDescription.en: Model providers may store data for up to 30 days for automated harm detection, never for training.
allowDataRetentionDescription.zh: 模型提供商可能保留数据最多 30 天，用于自动化危害检测，绝不用于训练。
